name: msgpack
description: Pure JS MessagePack (msgpack) binary serialization encoder and decoder. Highly optimized and zero-dependency.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need binary serialization of JSON-like data structures (arrays, objects, strings, numbers, booleans) to reduce network payload size or save raw binary buffers to disk.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data object to encode, or binary buffer to decode.
